thread:
Maria Lopez: Hey team — need quick help routing an ACME POC deal. 3-month POC, expected usage ~3M tokens/mo. Proposal on table: 20% off list for POC, $10k committed spend during POC, and standard Hosted SLA. Security Qs still outstanding (ACME sent a V2 questionnaire). Which CPQ/Salesforce fields do I need to populate so Deal Desk can approve quickly? Also: what approval path for >15% discounts?

Jake Chen: tagging for SE signoff @Maria — POC sounds fine. One ask: if we grant 20% but also give POC credit, we should record as two line items in CPQ (list price / credit) so billing shows the credit.

Priya Singh: @Maria please include:
- Discount % and Discount justification (field: Discount_Reason__c)
- Commit_Tier__c (e.g., "POC-3MO")
- Special_Terms__c (paste any SOW/POC SLOs)
- Approval_Routing__c (auto-populates based on discount)
- Attach pricing worksheet (link in attachments)
If discount >15% we route to Deal Desk -> RevOps -> VP Sales. SLA for approvals is 48h weekday, 72h if security review required.

Maria Lopez: thanks. Can you paste the exact CPQ keys I should use? I don't want to miss anything. Also where to attach the security questionnaire?

Priya Singh: use these fields in the CPQ quote metadata:
```
Discount_Percent__c: 20
Discount_Reason__c: "POC - enterprise eval"
Commit_Tier__c: "POC-3MO"
POC_Length__c: "90"
Special_Terms__c: "Attach SOW"
Approval_Routing__c: "auto"
Security_Questionnaire_Link__c: <link to uploaded doc>
Quote_Approval_Status__c: "Pending"
```
Attach the questionnaire to the Salesforce Files on the Account record (ACME Corp) and paste the share link into Security_Questionnaire_Link__c.

deal-desk-bot: Automated note: discount >15% detected. Routing rule: Deal Desk (Priya) -> RevOps (nora@redwood) -> VP Sales (escalate if >25%). Expected business hours SLA: 48 hours.

Nora Patel: @Priya @Maria I'm RevOps — confirm the commit structure. If the $10k is a true monetary commit (prepaid or invoiced), mark Commit_Type__c = "Monetary" and set Commit_Value__c = "10000". If it's just a trial credit, use Commit_Type__c = "Credit". Monetary commits affect MRR recognition, legal will want clear SOW.

Ava K.: Security quick note — ACME's questionnaire has two blockers: customer-managed keys + data residency. We can accept customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private only. For Hosted, explain limitations and propose encryption-in-transit + at-rest with BYOK roadmap. I'll review answers but need the uploaded questionnaire first. ETA 48 hours after receipt.

Maria Lopez: ok uploading questionnaire now to Salesforce Files and pasting link. One more: rate-card link? I want to cite the standard rate card in the quote note so Deal Desk can see list price.

Priya Singh: rate card v2 here: https://redwood.company/internal/rate-cards/v2 (internal). In the quote notes add: "List price per token: see rate_card_v2, POC pricing = 20% off list; POC credit shown as separate negative line item."

LegalOps Bot: Reminder: any special data residency or KMS terms require Legal review. Please attach SOW + any customer-provided DPA redlines. Legal review SLA ~3 business days.

Maria Lopez: thanks all — filling fields now. Will flag once uploaded and set Approval_Routing__c. @Priya I'll set Discount_Reason__c to "POC - enterprise evaluation" and attach SOW draft.

Priya Singh: perfect — once uploaded, ping in this thread and I'll kick the routing. If Deal Desk needs additional redlines, we'll loop Legal (Nora), and Ops (Ava) for security.

Jake Chen: SE note — for POC we should add a telemetry event to track token volumes; if it spikes >5M tokens/mo we should auto-suggest Dedicated capacity. I'll add a short note in Special_Terms__c.

Maria Lopez: uploaded: https://salesforce.com/files/ACME_Q_v2_security_questionnaire.pdf and SOW draft attached. Approval_Routing__c set to "auto".

Priya Singh: got it, starting approval flow now. Leaving a checklist for Deal Desk reviewers:
- [ ] Confirm Discount_Reason__c
- [ ] Verify Commit_Type__c and Commit_Value__c
- [ ] Security questionnaire reviewed by Ava
- [ ] Legal check for DPA redlines
- [ ] Final approval or escalate to VP Sales
ETA 48 hours (unless legal/security flags).

Maria Lopez: thank you! will update the ACME opportunity notes after approval. :thumbsup:

Ava K.: started security review. Will post comments inline in the questionnaire doc within 24-48h.

Priya Singh: closing loop — if anyone needs the CPQ template, use the "POC_3MO_template_v1" in the Quote Templates list. It pre-populates the fields above.

Maria Lopez: perfect — that should speed it up.

(End of thread)
